artifact_review:
The Router identified 'text_gibberish' as Severity 5. I strongly agree. For a menu, illegible text is a catastrophic structural failure, not just an aesthetic flaw. 
- Router noted 'texture_anomaly' (Severity 2) in the logo. I agree; the logo lacks the crisp edges of printed ink.
- Router noted 'perspective_distortion' (Severity 1). I agree; minor warping.
- Expert 'perceptual_quality_auditor' noted 'blur' (Severity 0.2/5 scale equivalent to ~1-2). This supports the slight softness observed.
- Expert 'image_text_auditor' confirmed total gibberish with low confidence scores (<0.65 for most blocks), validating the Severity 5 rating for text artifacts.
- No new artifacts found by experts that contradict the Router. The 'topology_boundary_auditor' gave a high mask confidence (0.96), indicating the paper object itself is structurally coherent (no melting/fusion of the paper sheet), which isolates the defect strictly to the surface texture (text).
alignment_reasoning: The image fails the primary functional requirement of the class 'menu': conveying readable information. While the visual layout (columns, headers, paper texture) mimics a menu successfully enough to be recognized as one by a human observer (and potentially a classifier relying on shape), it fails the taxonomic definition of a 'listing of available food... items'. The Fine-Grained Classifier ranked 'slide rule' and 'binder' higher than 'menu', indicating that even the AI model struggles to classify it confidently due to the lack of semantic text content. Only 4/9 checkpoints passed (mostly material/aesthetic), while all functional/textual checkpoints failed.
artifact_reasoning: The dominant artifact is 'text_gibberish' (Severity 5). The text is not just blurry; it is structurally nonsensical character hallucinations. This renders the object functionally broken. Secondary artifacts include slight blur/smudging in the logo and minor perspective warping. The paper structure itself is intact (high topology mask confidence), so there are no geometric melting issues with the object boundary, only the surface pattern (text) is defective.
key_defects: Functional failure (cannot serve as a menu)
